items.text: P0.1 Author the eight concern-class policies (C1–C8) in .claude/epr-meta/policies.yaml, Precedent shape, versioned, each with statement / scope predicate / binding class / why / dispatch-agent
P0.2 Add an invariant→probe row per concern to the substrate trust-contract runbook, naming the live meter that watches it
P0.3 Convert the inline heal-fills-never-moves rule in elohim/elohim-storage/src/.epr-meta to a binding of the C2 policy (bind-don't-redefine advisory disappears; placement-audit.py --epr-meta green)

P0.4 Brit-liftability gate for every artifact this plan creates: concern policies, seam-registry rows, and matrix snapshots have content-addressable bodies with declared-head identity and standing separated from content (id@version stand-in per the policy-registry spec; a fixture proves a policy body round-trips to a CIDv1 via the brit/eprfs address path without rewriting)

P1.1 Create crates/seam-contracts with Answer<T> (Present/Absent/Unreachable), the reason-labeled-outcome convention + conformance test, and the Arbitrated (permutation-invariance) and Quiescent (settled-state fixed point) property harnesses
P2.1 Implement the Liveness table harness (state-space enumeration; every non-terminal state has ≥1 enabled transition) over decide_head_action + admission predicates
P2.2 Regression demonstration: harness FAILS against a reconstructed pre-wave-5 predicate fixture and PASSES current
P3.1 Author seam-registry.yaml for elohim-storage and the content_store zome (every pure decision predicate + the concern ids it answers + its contract-test citations)
P3.2 Census check wired into placement-audit.py --epr-meta: both directions verified; fixtures prove missing-registration and missing-contract-test each fail loud
P4.1 Register + evaluate the first two concrete validators (heal-fills-never-moves, bounded-work) per the policies.yaml transitional guidance; fixture diff triggers the class-ladder verdict
P4.2 Cascade: a policy version bump on a fixture yields one fingerprinted finding per stale-pinned bound point and dispatches via the sentinel pattern with measure-tier debounce

P4.3 Concern × seam matrix generated by the census (rows C1–C8, columns = registered points grouped by seam-map track; cells conformant/variant/unexamined/n-a); surfaced by placement-audit.py --epr-meta beside the Gap Ledger
P4.4 Trajectory-crossed forecast: rank unexamined cells against the roadmap's next rungs; emit the forecasted-collision list at ceremony time

P4.5 Design-time birth rule: bind p2p-design-gate + the compose-gate so a new decision predicate / boundary answer type / sync message cannot be born unregistered — its design answers each concern class or declares n-a
